Introduction

Jeon HeeJin is a South Korean singer-songwriter and dancer under MODHAUS. She is a member of the project girl group ARTMS. She is also a member of the girl group LOONA and its first sub-unit LOONA 1/3, although the group is currently inactive.

On May 9, 2023, she debuted as a member of the virtual project group FE:VERSE under the name Rien.

On May 31, 2024, Heejin debuted as a member of ARTMS with their first album "Dall".
